subject: Remote evidence parity and inspector access plan
messages:
From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@acmehealth.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: ACME Compliance Team <privacy@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence parity for remote inspection — initial ask

Hi Markus / Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Our audit team has one follow-up: for remote inspections we need to demonstrate that evidence we provide from Redwood is functionally equivalent to what an on-site auditor would see (control evidence, extractability, timestamp fidelity, and configuration snippets).

Can you confirm:
- Whether the exported Art.30 records include provenance metadata (UTC timestamps + host id)
- If we can provide a time-limited inspector account (SAML) or a read-only snapshot export for the audit window
- A short runbook that maps your operational artifacts to our checklist (we attached ACME's inspection checklist for reference)

Goal: get confirmation and a draft runbook by EOD Thursday so our audit can proceed next week.

Best,
Elena Gomez
Head of Privacy Operations
Acme Health

Attachment: ACME-inspection-checklist.pdf (referenced)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence parity for remote inspection — initial ask

Elena — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned on the ask and have a small cross-functional plan to deliver. Quick answers up front:
- Art.30 exports include per-record UTC timestamps and a service node identifier, and we can include a processing provenance field in the CSV/JSON extract.
- We can provision a time-limited inspector role via SAML for the audit window; it will be read-only and scoped to the tenant.
- We'll produce a 1–2 page mapping runbook that points each ACME checklist item to a Redwood artifact (logs, ledger extract, policy snapshot).

Action items we own:
1) Aditya: produce a sample Art.30 extract with provenance fields and a short validation script.
2) Camila: draft the runbook mapping and the list of artifacts we will surface.
3) Laura: validate retention windows and attest which tables/ledgers are included.

We'll attach a compact checklist and the SAML config snippet for your IdP to test staging SSO by Thursday EOD. If your audit requires an on-demand export workflow, please call that out and we can include an export playbook.

Regards,
Markus Klein
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: inspection-checklist-v2.pdf (forthcoming), SAML-config-snippet.txt

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@acmehealth.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence parity for remote inspection — sample extract

Markus / Laura / Elena,

I've attached a redacted sample Art.30 export (CSV) and a tiny validation script we run to check timestamp monotonicity and the host_id mapping. Notes:
- Fields included: record_id, processed_at_utc, host_id, processing_stage, source_bucket, checksum
- Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC. We add sub-second precision when available.
- For audits we can include a signature (HMAC) over the file with a retrieval log to prove immutability within the audit window.

For the SAML inspector we suggest a 7-day window initially and will log every inspector session with ip/agent and an attestation row in the ledger.

Let me know if you want the sample in JSON instead or additional fields.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample-art30-redacted.csv (attached), validation-snippet.py (attached)

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence parity for remote inspection — runbook draft and scheduling

Elena — attaching a first-pass 2-page runbook that maps ACME's checklist items to Redwood artifacts. Highlights:
- "Configuration and policy": linked to policy snapshots + S3 retention manifests.
- "Processing ledger": Art.30 extract and ledger extract with provenance fields.
- "Audit access": SAML inspector (read-only) + pre-seeded snapshot export option.

Proposed timeline:
- Wed 07/22: Your team tests SAML staging (we'll provision the IdP metadata).
- Thu 07/23 EOD: We deliver final runbook and redacted sample exports.
- Mon 07/27: Remote inspection window (if you approve).

Can you confirm whom we should provision for the staging test (emails)? Also, are you OK with a 7-day inspector access window?

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Manager, Customer Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: runbook-mapping-v1.pdf

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@acmehealth.com>, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence parity for remote inspection — confirmation and attachments

Elena — quick confirmation from retention/ops side:
- Retention windows for the audit window are in scope and we will include the relevant ledger slices in the export.
- We'll attach the finalized inspection checklist mapping (small edits from Camila's draft) and the SAML config snippet for your IdP team.
- We will enable session logging and include an attestation row in the ledger for each inspector session.

Next steps for ACME: please provide the staging IdP metadata and a list of test accounts (emails) to provision. We'll aim to have provisioning and sample exports ready by Thu 07/23 EOD.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Privacy Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: inspection-checklist-v2.pdf, SAML-config-snippet.txt
